extracted.intended_audience: Applicants and research administrators preparing NIH PHS 398 Career Development (K) grant applications (e.g., K08) and associated budgets
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit a PHS 398 Career Development Award (K) application including the Research & Related budget (Sections A–K), budget justification, candidate and mentor materials, human subjects/animals protections, and required supplemental attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section A: Senior/Key Person
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Senior/Key Person entries including Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary ($), Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), and Funds Requested ($); report Total Funds Requested for all Senior Key Persons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter effort in calendar months (and academic/summer months where applicable). Include base salary, requested salary and fringe for each senior/key person; supply additional Senior/Key Persons file if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section B: Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: List number of personnel and for each project role (e.g., Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical) provide Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits, and Funds Requested ($); report Total Number Other Personnel and Total Other Personnel dollars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate salaries, wages and fringe benefits across Sections A and B to report Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits (A+B).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section C: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000; report Total funds requested for all equipment listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only list items and dollar amounts for equipment exceeding $5,000; include additional equipment attachments/files as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section D: Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide funds requested for Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs, and compute Total Travel Cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out domestic vs foreign travel; include travel related expenses (airfare, accommodations, per diem) in justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section E: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide funds requested for Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, and Other, and report Number of Participants/Trainees and Total Participant Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate participant/trainee support costs from other direct costs; report counts and totals clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section F: Other Direct Costs (Materials & Supplies etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Other Direct Costs such as (1) Materials and Supplies, (2) Publication Costs, (3) Consultant Services, (4) ADP/Computer Services, (5) Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, (6) Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, (7) Alterations and Renovations, and report Total Other Direct Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Career Development awards, research development support may be entered under Other Direct Costs (Materials and Supplies); provide yearly breakouts and examples (tuition, travel, publication fees, reagents, core services).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section G: Direct Costs Total
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Total Direct Costs (sum of Sections A through F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure sums across sections are consistent and match budget justification narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section H: Indirect Costs (F&A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($); identify the Indirect Cost Base (e.g., Modified Total Direct Costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the institution’s negotiated DHHS rate (example shows 8% MTDC for MGH Career Development Awards); explicitly state the cognizant federal agency contact (agency name, POC, phone). Note exclusions (e.g., tuition and fees excluded from MTDC base).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section I: Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify that totals equal the sum of direct costs and indirect costs; use these totals in the application summary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section J: Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide any Fee requested (if applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most NIH grants do not include a fee; report zero when not applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — file and content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach a Budget Justification file (K. Budget Justification) explaining requested costs; the form notes: 'K. Budget Justification* File Name: FINAL_Budget_Justification.pdf Mime Type: application/pdf (Only attach one file.)'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach only one Budget Justification file; justify salary requests, fringe, materials/supplies, travel, publication costs, core services, and other listed budget line-items with year-by-year detail as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: K-Award Candidate Effort Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidate must commit a minimum of 9 calendar months (75% effort) for the duration of the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This commitment is presented in the Budget Justification (example: 'Dr. Lu will commit a minimum of 9 calendar months (75% effort) for the duration of this project') and is an eligibility/award condition for many career development (K) awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentor, Co-Mentor, Consultant, Collaborators — roles and letters
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide mentor(s) and co-mentor(s) identification and include Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-Mentor(s) and Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors, and Consultants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe mentor expertise, roles, and level of involvement; include mentor letters as separate attachments (e.g., FINAL_Mentor_Letter.pdf) and indicate whether mentors request salary support (example: no salary support requested).

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate Section and Career Development Plan content
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development, Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List (if renewal), and Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative describing career goals, prior experience, planned training, coursework, mentorship, and how the award will support transition to independence; attach required files for each subsection as indicated in the supplement checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in Responsible Conduct of Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a plan and documentation for Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach RCR training documentation (e.g., FINAL_Training_in_the_Responsible_Conduct_of_Research.pdf) per PHS 398 instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Environment and Institutional Commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the institutional environment and provide Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development (attachments required).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institution must document commitment of support, protected time, and resources for the candidate (attach Final_Institutional_Commitment.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects and Data Safety Monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete the Protection of Human Subjects section and, if applicable, provide a Data Safety Monitoring Plan (DSM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the project is a clinical trial; include the Protection of Human Subjects attachment (e.g., 06072016_FINAL_Protection_of_Human_Subjects.pdf). Address risks, protections, consent, and monitoring mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women, Minorities, and Children
rubrics_metrics.description: Address Inclusion of Women and Minorities and Inclusion of Children in the application; provide these sections as attachments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide justification and plans for inclusion or scientific rationale for exclusion; attach inclusion documents (e.g., 06072016_Inclusion_of_women_and_minorities.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals — euthanasia and AVMA guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: If vertebrate animals are used, indicate whether animals are euthanized and whether the method is consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines; if not consistent, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer euthanasia question and, when applicable, provide method description and justification; include Vertebrate Animals section attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether program income is anticipated during the requested periods; if 'Yes', list Anticipated Amount ($) and Source(s) by Budget Period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no program income is anticipated, leave blank or indicate 'No'. If yes, provide amounts and sources in the format requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) registry requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells; if yes, list the registration number(s) of the specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or check that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry numbers or indicate that a registry line will be used (refer to http://grants.nih.gov/stem_cells/registry/current.htm).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether Inventions and Patents are involved and, if 'Yes', indicate whether they were Previously Reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Inventions and Patents section for renewals and report earlier disclosures as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information when requesting a Change of Project Director/Principal Investigator or Change of Grantee Institution (name of former PD/PI or former institution, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIH procedures for requesting and documenting changes in PD/PI or grantee institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Research Plan Sections and required attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Include other research plan sections as applicable: Select Agent Research, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Resource Sharing, Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach relevant plans (e.g., FINAL_Resource_Sharing_Plan.pdf, FINAL_Authentication_of_Key_Biological.pdf) and document consortium/subaward arrangements and resource sharing commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Placement of training and course costs in budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Place tuition and course fees associated with career development training in the budget justification under Other Direct Costs (Materials and Supplies) as appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'Tuition and Fees: Formal coursework to be completed in Years 1 and 2… The registration fee for Seeing is Believing EMBL in Year 1 is ($…). The tuition for Quantitative Imaging at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory in Year 2 is $…' — show year-by-year amounts and note which courses are free.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials and Supplies — examples and categories to justify
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify Materials and Supplies requests with specific examples such as registration fees, travel for courses/conferences, publication fees, reagents, core service charges (Microarray, Flow cytometry, Microscopy, BSL3), and consumables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide per-year dollar amounts and examples of items to be purchased; clarify core service usage and estimated costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Cost calculation and MTDC exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Calculate Indirect Costs using the negotiated Indirect Cost Rate applied to an Indirect Cost Base (e.g., Modified Total Direct Costs); explicitly state items excluded from the MTDC base (example: tuition and fees).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the negotiated rate and base used (e.g., 'Indirect Costs of were calculated based on a Modified Total Direct Costs rate of 8% consistent with Massachusetts General Hospital’s negotiated DHHS rate for Career Development Awards. The tuition and fees costs, identified above, are excluded from the MTDC base.').

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative Budget Totals and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide cumulative budget totals across sections (A–J) including totals for Salary/Wages/Fringe, Equipment, Travel, Participant Costs, Other Direct Costs, Direct Costs, Indirect Costs, Total Direct and Indirect Costs, and Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present a cumulative budget table summarizing dollar amounts per section and ensure consistency with detailed budgets and budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment naming and checklist adherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the supplemental form checklist for required attachments and use clear file names (e.g., FINAL_Specific_Aims.pdf, FINAL_Mentor_Letter.pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form lists numbered attachments (Introduction, Candidate Information, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Training in RCR, Mentor Letters, Institutional Commitment, Protection of Human Subjects, etc.) — include each required file and adhere to the 'Only attach one file' instruction for Budget Justification.
